Work look: wireframe the shared parts
• Text label beside each pop-up → a search field, then compact menus ("Label ▾"); a set filter shows its value in the accent.
• Refresh link → a toolbar icon (⌘R on the Mac, pull to refresh on the phone).
• State pill → a state icon at the start. Grey chips → chips in the label's colour.
• "No agent yet" → author, age, comments, avatars; lineage only when there is some.
